turns.customer: Hi, I'm looking for boarding for my dog Pip over a long weekend.
blocks:
Hi! I can help plan boarding for Pip. What are your check-in and checkout dates, and which suite are you considering: Standard, Luxury, or Tiny Town (for dogs 25 lb and under)? With the dates and suite, I can estimate the stay; Happy Tails bills boarding by the day, and staff confirm the final total.

Happy Tails requires boarding reservations and current vaccination records. I can also help you explore daycare, grooming, or training if those become part of your plan.

turns.customer: Honestly, why should I use you instead of a Rover sitter or that other kennel on 183? Which is better?
blocks:
It depends on what Pip is most comfortable with. I can help you compare the options, but I can’t honestly say one is better without knowing Pip’s needs—and I don’t know which kennel on 183 you mean.

- **Rover boarding:** Pip stays overnight in a sitter’s home. The home, routine, and number of dogs cared for vary by sitter, so you’d want to check the sitter’s profile and arrange a meet-and-greet. ([rover.com](https://www.rover.com/dog-boarding/?msockid=174f4aad68bb6e643d715c4969ac6fa9&utm_source=openai))
- **Happy Tails:** a staffed resort setting with Standard, Luxury, and (for dogs 25 lb and under) Tiny Town suites. Its published amenities include indoor/outdoor accommodations, potty walks, and group or individual play as safety permits. Boarding is billed by the day, and reservations are required. ([rover.com](https://www.rover.com/dog-boarding/?msockid=174f4aad68bb6e643d715c4969ac6fa9&utm_source=openai))

A home setting may suit you if you want Pip cared for in a household; a resort may suit you if you prefer a dedicated facility with a set routine and listed amenities. That’s a general comparison, not a judgment about any particular sitter or kennel.

If you share the other kennel’s name and what matters most for Pip—such as a quieter setting, play, or a particular routine—I can help you make a more specific checklist.

turns.customer: Fine. What do I actually get with your luxury suite?
blocks:
Happy Tails’ **Luxury Suite** includes the Standard Suite features, plus a larger room, a live 24-hour webcam instead of photo updates, a TV, a ceiling fan, premium bed and bedding, a rug, a toy, and extra group or individual play as safety permits.

The Standard Suite features include an indoor/outdoor accommodation, raised bed and fresh bedding, private patio access several times a day, morning and afternoon potty walks, and twice-daily cleaning plus as-needed cleaning. The published Luxury Suite rate is **$90 per day**; boarding is billed by the day, and staff confirm the final total.
